subject: Validate node ID when decoding open slots RDB aux field (#4098)
reason: The change only alters clusterDecodeOpenSlotsAuxField, which returns early unless RDBFLAGS_REPLICATION is set, so it runs solely during a live full sync and never for an RDB file, DEBUG RELOAD, or valkey-check-rdb. The aux field's only producer is clusterEncodeOpenSlotsAuxField, which always emits each open slot's node->name as exactly 40 valid hex bytes plus a ',' delimiter (and CLUSTER SETSLOT IMPORTING/MIGRATING only accepts already-known nodes), so every reachable decode receives a well-formed node ID that both builds accept byte-for-byte identically.
